desc:
🍮 JELLY HOUSE ESCAPE 🍮

You wake up in a house packed with wobbly jelly. The only way out? EAT YOUR WAY OUT! 🥄

😋 Scoop jelly until your belly is full, then DUMP IT for coins!

🔧 Upgrade from a tiny Spoon to the Big Spoon and the Vacuum. Rent the 🔥 Heat Blower to melt jelly straight into coins!

🏠 Rooms come in waves: clear one and the jelly comes back! Beat the last wave to open the next door, find the 🔑 Front Key and escape!

🧸 Find 7 hidden collectibles buried in the jelly.

👥 Team up with up to 4 friends and pick Easy, Normal or Hard for bigger rewards.

💎 Earn gems in the lobby for classes, upgrades and daily rewards.

🎁 CODES 🎁
🍌 BANANA → 150 Gems
🍮 JELLY → 50 Gems
🚀 RELEASE → 100 Gems
👥 GROUP → 200 Gems (join the group first!)
⭐  UPD2 →  200 Gems

⭐ Join the group for free gems and +10% coins!

👍 Like and favourite for more rooms and tools!
